topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Hallmarks of Cancer Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture objectives, outlines the historical framework of cancer hallmarks, and establishes the central role of loss of growth control in tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Autonomous Proliferation and Growth Signal Transduction
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations in cell-surface receptor pathways, including Wnt, RTK, and TGF-beta cascades, drive sustained proliferation and survival signaling.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells arrest normal maturation programs across hematological lineages and intestinal crypt epithelium to maintain an uncommitted proliferative state.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through mutations disrupting p53 regulation and altering the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic mitochondrial factors.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Cellular Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells achieve indefinite replication through telomerase reactivation while bypassing p53-mediated DNA damage arrest and cellular senescence.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the Warburg effect, metabolic rewiring across different tumor types, and the role of metabolic enzyme mutations in producing oncometabolites that alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address why expanding tumors require new blood vessel formation, when the angiogenic switch occurs, and how the balance between activating and inhibitory factors governs vascularisation.

topics.label: Metastatic Dissemination and Colonisation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the multi-step metastatic cascade from local tissue invasion and circulatory transport to the seed-and-soil dynamics and genomic traits of secondary tumors.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer summarises the collective action of cancer hallmarks, references advanced literature, and concludes the session before the practicals.
